0601636641ff59bb9e55e3f3.text: The Ticket opens on its Overview, below its status and priority: its CVE, its packages, and its details.

1b516421c98083b25dc93854.text: In the list, the Deadline column shows the next deadline of each Ticket, in red once it has passed.

27a68493af25a94450948da3.text: Aura opens the Ticket list. Next to its heading, the attention summary counts the Tickets that need attention.

2b34d4f6d66875a5057fba63.text: The new reference shows in the table: a manual reference, uncategorized, with the time it was added.

348e5da60278c17d0e2059e6.text: The reference that you added is the latest event, with who added it and when.

3ed1de35de8122274fc4671d.text: To read the advisories, patches, and reports about the Ticket, open the tab References.

54c644f87663e95959214988.text: To see every change of the Ticket, and what Sentinel did by itself, open the tab Audit log.

57357d73a944be511e260287.text: To see your Tickets in Analysis or Analyzed, open the view Assigned to me.

6ce697a1059d47a6f8a3b2df.text: Press Escape to close the explanation.

72a22934cd4fe185e385e7d7.text: To record a new one, select Add reference.

79d9b26883dfbf3d3d8dd27f.text: Next to the heading, the attention summary counts the active P1 Tickets, the embargoes that have expired, and the Tickets overdue in each phase, from Triage to QA.

8651d6204b36427f358ea7ba.text: Enter a title: it is optional, and makes the reference easier to find.

96d153d8345e60924f21c4c7.text: Below, the packages show where SUSE stands for each codestream and its Products: here, affected.

98ccb6624a17bc27330cad3b.text: Press Enter to keep the Tickets that match: here, the Ticket of the CVE.

9de524aafabbfb1a44abef7c.text: Select Add reference in the dialog to add it to the Ticket.

a6c4f00a060786ca3ac45e9e.text: From the Ticket list, enter the identifier of the CVE in the search.

ac3b2a6fa53d1e116d6e4d44.text: To open the Ticket, select its identifier.

b47465e1764802dab8ef557b.text: As an analyst, you land on the New view, the queue of new Tickets.

c4e041b3c93fff4ce22e8cd3.text: Enter the address of the page.

cf125205748aa0c5580c28bb.text: The priority in the heading explains itself: select it.

e75122461ca0850d9afca86f.text: This priority is an override: the explanation says who set it and when, and the priority that Sentinel computed from the severity and the exploitation.

eaccfe487aa35d08eda3f6e6.text: Open Sentinel Aura in your browser. If you aren't signed in, it shows Sign in.

fbaacf94c2a20db428d6ffbf.text: The heading of the Ticket shows its CVE, its status, its severity, and its priority.
